name: Shif Content Restriction for Elementor
author: Shifkat Ahamed Siddiqui

sections.description: Shif Content Restriction for Elementor gives you rapid, granular control over your layouts. It allows site administrators to lock down entire section containers or individual widgets with just a single click, prompting unauthorized users with a beautifully styled, premium blur glassmorphism overlay containing a secure iFrame login modal.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open any Elementor Page or Template, select a Container, and navigate to the “Content Restriction” settings tab in the Advanced panel.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro for this to work?

No, this plugin functions perfectly with both the free version of Elementor and Elementor Pro.

Does it support custom redirect URLs?

Yes, you can configure your own custom login or registration redirection paths directly within the container control settings panel.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Refactored plugin headers and structure for directory compliance.
  • Enqueued frontend modal and form handling scripts cleanly via WordPress hook architectures.
  • Fixed cross-site scripting vulnerabilities by adding context-specific late escaping to dynamic URLs.
